SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE
		WHEN type IN ('charge','hold','settle') THEN credits
		WHEN type = 'refund' THEN -credits
		ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total
		FROM billing_transactions WHERE user_id = ?

WITH grouped AS (
		SELECT COALESCE(corr_id, 'tx:' || id::text) AS request_key,
		       COALESCE(MIN(created_at) FILTER (WHERE type IN ('charge','hold','settle')), MIN(created_at)) AS usage_at,
		       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('charge','hold','settle') THEN credits WHEN type = 'refund' THEN -credits ELSE 0 END), 0) AS credits
		FROM billing_transactions WHERE user_id = ? GROUP BY COALESCE(corr_id, 'tx:' || id::text)
	) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(credits), 0) AS total FROM grouped WHERE usage_at >= ? AND usage_at < ?

WITH grouped AS (
		SELECT COALESCE(corr_id, 'tx:' || id::text) AS request_key,
		       COALESCE(MIN(created_at) FILTER (WHERE type IN ('charge','hold','settle')), MIN(created_at)) AS usage_at,
		       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('charge','hold','settle') THEN credits
				WHEN type = 'refund' THEN -credits
				ELSE 0 END), 0) AS credits
		FROM billing_transactions WHERE user_id = ? GROUP BY COALESCE(corr_id, 'tx:' || id::text)
	) SELECT TO_CHAR(usage_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD') AS day,
		COALESCE(SUM(CASE
			WHEN credits IS NOT NULL THEN credits ELSE 0 END), 0) AS credits
		FROM grouped WHERE usage_at >= ? AND usage_at < ?
		GROUP BY TO_CHAR(usage_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD'), DATE_TRUNC('day', usage_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
		ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('day', usage_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')

SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at::date, 'MM-DD') AS day,
		COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN 1 END) AS success,
		COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 END) AS failed
		FROM llm_logs
		WHERE user_id = ? AND created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?
		GROUP BY created_at::date ORDER BY created_at::date

WITH grouped AS (
 SELECT COALESCE(corr_id, 'tx:' || id::text) AS request_key,
 COALESCE(MIN(created_at) FILTER (WHERE type IN ('charge','hold','settle')), MIN(created_at)) AS usage_at,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('charge','hold','settle') THEN credits WHEN type = 'refund' THEN -credits ELSE 0 END),0) AS credits
 FROM billing_transactions WHERE user_id = ? GROUP BY COALESCE(corr_id, 'tx:' || id::text)
 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TO_CHAR(usage_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD')) = 1 THEN COALESCE(SUM(credits),0) ELSE COALESCE(SUM(credits) FILTER (WHERE usage_at >= ? AND usage_at < ?),0) END AS total,
 COALESCE(SUM(credits) FILTER (WHERE usage_at >= ? AND usage_at < ?),0) AS today,
 TO_CHAR(usage_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD') AS day,
 DATE_TRUNC('day', usage_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS day_order,
 GROUPING(TO_CHAR(usage_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD')) AS is_total
 FROM grouped
 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((), (TO_CHAR(usage_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD'), DATE_TRUNC('day', usage_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')))
 HAVING GROUPING(TO_CHAR(usage_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD')) = 1
 OR BOOL_OR(usage_at >= ? AND usage_at < ?)
 ORDER BY day_order

SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at::date, 'MM-DD') AS day,
		COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN 1 END) AS success,
		COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 END) AS failed
		FROM llm_logs
		WHERE user_id = ? AND created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?
		GROUP BY created_at::date ORDER BY created_at::date

WITH corr_keys AS (
			SELECT corr_id, MAX(api_key_id) AS api_key_id
			FROM billing_transactions
			WHERE user_id = ? AND api_key_id > 0 AND corr_id <> ''
				AND type IN ('charge','hold','settle')
			GROUP BY corr_id
		), attributed AS (
			SELECT CASE
				WHEN bt.api_key_id > 0 THEN bt.api_key_id
				WHEN bt.type = 'refund' THEN COALESCE(ck.api_key_id, 0)
				ELSE 0
			END AS stats_api_key_id, bt.type, bt.credits, bt.created_at
			FROM billing_transactions bt
			LEFT JOIN corr_keys ck ON ck.corr_id = bt.corr_id
			WHERE bt.user_id = ?
		)
		SELECT stats_api_key_id AS api_key_id,
			COALESCE(SUM(CASE
				WHEN type IN ('charge','hold','settle') THEN credits
				WHEN type = 'refund' THEN -credits
				ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_consumed,
			COALESCE(SUM(CASE
				WHEN created_at >= ? AND created_at < ? THEN
					CASE
						WHEN type IN ('charge','hold','settle') THEN credits
						WHEN type = 'refund' THEN -credits
						ELSE 0
					END
				ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_consumed
		FROM attributed
		WHERE stats_api_key_id > 0
		GROUP BY stats_api_key_id

WITH scoped AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT ll.id, ll.model, ll.corr_id, ll.status, ll.created_at, ll.usage,
 COALESCE(c.protocol, 'openai') AS protocol,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY NULLIF(ll.corr_id, '') ORDER BY ll.id DESC) AS corr_rank
 FROM llm_logs ll LEFT JOIN channels c ON c.id = ll.channel_id
 WHERE ll.user_id = $1 AND ll.created_at >= $2 AND ll.created_at < $3
), ledger AS (
 SELECT b.corr_id, SUM(CASE WHEN b.type IN ('hold','charge','settle','consume') THEN b.credits
 WHEN b.type = 'refund' THEN -b.credits ELSE 0 END) AS credits
 FROM billing_transactions b
 WHERE b.user_id = $1 AND b.corr_id <> ''
 AND b.corr_id IN (SELECT corr_id FROM scoped WHERE status IN ('ok','error'))
 GROUP BY b.corr_id
), normalized AS (
 SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN
 CASE WHEN LOWER(protocol) = 'claude' THEN COALESCE((usage->>'prompt_tokens')::bigint,0)
 ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE((usage->>'prompt_tokens')::bigint,0)-COALESCE((usage->>'cache_read_tokens')::bigint,0),0) END
 ELSE 0 END AS input,
 CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN COALESCE((usage->>'cache_read_tokens')::bigint,0) ELSE 0 END AS cache_read,
 CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN COALESCE((usage->>'cache_creation_tokens')::bigint,0) ELSE 0 END AS cache_write,
 CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN COALESCE((usage->>'completion_tokens')::bigint,0) ELSE 0 END AS output,
 CASE WHEN status IN ('ok','error') AND corr_rank = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.credits,0) ELSE 0 END AS credits
 FROM scoped s LEFT JOIN ledger l ON l.corr_id = s.corr_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN created_at >= $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period,
 DATE_TRUNC($5, created_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS bucket,
 model, COUNT(*) AS requests,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS success,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'error') AS failed,
 SUM(credits), SUM(input), SUM(cache_read), SUM(cache_write), SUM(output)
FROM normalized GROUP BY period, bucket, model ORDER BY bucket, model

WITH samples AS (
 SELECT model,status,GREATEST(TRUNC(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at-created_at))*1000),0)::bigint AS latency,
 CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(usage->'performance_ttft_ms')='number' THEN (usage->>'performance_ttft_ms')::double precision END AS ttft,
 CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(usage->'performance_tps')='number' THEN (usage->>'performance_tps')::double precision END AS tps
 FROM llm_logs WHERE created_at >= $1 AND model IN ('gpt') AND status <> 'pending'
 ), summary AS (
 SELECT model,COUNT(*) AS total,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status='ok') AS success,
 COALESCE(percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY latency) FILTER(WHERE status='ok'),0) AS latency,
 percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY ttft) FILTER(WHERE status='ok' AND ttft>=0) AS ttft,
 percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY tps) FILTER(WHERE status='ok' AND tps>0) AS tps,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status='ok' AND ttft>=0) AS ttft_samples,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status='ok' AND tps>0) AS tps_samples
 FROM samples GROUP BY model
 ) SELECT s.model,s.total,s.success,s.latency,s.ttft,s.tps,s.ttft_samples,s.tps_samples,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('status',r.status,'latency_ms',r.latency,'created_at',r.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id)
 FROM (SELECT id,status,created_at,GREATEST(TRUNC(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at-created_at))*1000),0)::bigint AS latency
 FROM llm_logs WHERE model=s.model AND created_at >= $1 AND status <> 'pending' ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 60) r)
 FROM summary s ORDER BY s.model
